newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends barely changed, support at 845.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends barely changed, support at 845.

text.p: The won closed little changed against the dollar on Tuesday after central bank intervention built up heavy support at 845, traders said.
But the Bank of Korea denied stepping in, as it routinely does.
The won finished at 844.90 after opening at 844.80. It traded in a range of 844.30 to 845.00.

Traders said the sentiment was bearish towards the local unit from the opening as banks accumulated dollars. The central bank rescued the falling won in the early trading, but it wasn't enough to overturn the trend, they said.
"The dollar continued to test the resistance at 845 in the afternoon but failed to rise further," said one trader.
Traders said some banks started building up long dollar positions on expectations of a further decline in the local currency early next year.
The base mid-rate is seen at 844.60 on Friday, compared with 844.20 on Tuesday.
The foreign exchange market will be closed on Wednesday and Thursday for the New Year holidays.
